standard.summary: 检测到 loss 进入平台期时自动降低学习率，尝试突破平台继续收敛。
standard.effect: 触发时将学习率乘以 ac_lr_decay_factor，最多触发 ac_max_decays 次。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练中 loss 反复出现平台期时开启，让训练器自动微调 LR 突破瓶颈。
standard.avoidWhen: 配合 cosine/rex 等本身带衰减的 scheduler 时意义不大，可能造成 LR 双重衰减。

standard_en.summary: Lowers the learning rate automatically once the loss is detected to be on a plateau, trying to break through and keep converging.
standard_en.effect: Each trigger multiplies the LR by ac_lr_decay_factor, at most ac_max_decays times.
standard_en.whenToUse: On long runs where the loss keeps hitting plateaus -- it lets the trainer nudge the LR itself.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Of little value together with a scheduler that already decays, such as cosine or rex; you may end up with a double decay.

advanced.principle: 评估 loss 平台（基于 loss_plateau_window 窗口），若确认平台则触发 lr *= ac_lr_decay_factor，并记录衰减次数（最多 max_decays 次）。
advanced.tradeoffs: LR 衰减不可逆，多次触发后可能导致 LR 过低而训练停滞。建议 max_decays 不超过 3~5。

advanced_en.principle: Evaluates the loss plateau (over the loss_plateau_window window); on confirmation, triggers lr *= ac_lr_decay_factor and records the decay count (at most max_decays times).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: LR decay is irreversible; repeated triggers can leave LR so low that training stalls. Keep max_decays at 3~5 or fewer.
